She holds a white pair of panties toward the camera before tossing them away. (2) The scene shifts as she poses with her hands on her hips against a white wall illuminated by bright green ambient lighting. (3) A small graphic overlay appears on the left side showing various patterns and colors of underwear in circular icons while she continues to move rhythmically. (5) The woman's face is shown in a close-up as she tilts her head slightly, followed by white text appearing at the bottom. (6) A final cut shows a low-resolution video of a crowd of men in an outdoor park setting, cheering and screaming hysterically, with animated character heads superimposed on their bodies.
